name: kru
description: A local-first engine for persistent AI agent teammates

scripts.test:providers: bun test test/providers.test.ts test/permissions.test.ts test/provider-runtime.test.ts test/provider-liveness.test.ts test/token-usage.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build:web && bun test
scripts.test:scheduler: bun test test/scheduler.test.ts test/mailbox-batch.test.ts test/scheduler-cli.test.ts test/store.test.ts test/codex-retirement.test.ts test/budget-day.test.ts test/pricing.test.ts test/usage-ledger.test.ts
scripts.test:scheduler:repeat: bun test --rerun-each 10 test/scheduler.test.ts test/mailbox-batch.test.ts test/scheduler-cli.test.ts test/store.test.ts test/codex-retirement.test.ts test/budget-day.test.ts test/pricing.test.ts test/usage-ledger.test.ts
scripts.test:release:repeat: bun test --rerun-each 10 test/release.test.ts test/messaging.test.ts test/messaging-providers.test.ts test/threads.test.ts test/threads-providers.test.ts test/m6-expanded.test.ts test/boot/recovery.test.ts
scripts.check:release: bun run check && bun run test:release:repeat && bun run demo:recovery && git diff --check
scripts.ui: bun run build:web && bun src/cli/index.ts ui
scripts.test:workspace: bun test test/workspace.test.ts test/memory.test.ts test/work.test.ts test/workflows.test.ts test/conversations.test.ts test/web.test.ts
scripts.desktop: bun run build:web && bun scripts/build-desktop-bridges.ts && electron desktop/main.cjs
scripts.lint: eslint src/web/client desktop scripts/*.cjs eslint.config.js && bun run lint:dead
scripts.format: prettier --write src desktop scripts test package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js knip.jsonc .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src desktop scripts test package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js knip.jsonc .prettierrc.json
